user.title: Connect Wiser Workspace
user.description: Enter the address of the computer that runs the Wiser Workspace app and its integration token. Plain HTTP is unencrypted: use it only on a network you trust. HTTPS needs a certificate that Home Assistant trusts.

data_description.host: Address of the computer running the app, without http:// or a path.
data_description.port: The app's integration listener port (3443 by default).
data_description.ssl: Leave off for the default plain HTTP listener. Certificate verification cannot be disabled.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace the Wiser Workspace token
reauth_confirm.description: The integration token was rejected. Enter the current WISER_INTEGRATION_TOKEN of the app.

reconfigure.title: Change the Wiser Workspace connection
reconfigure.description: Update the address of the app, for example after its computer got a new IP address. It must still serve the same gateway.

error.invalid_url: Enter an IP address or hostname without http://, a path or credentials, and a port from 1 to 65535.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot fetch a valid workspace snapshot. Check the address, port, HTTP/HTTPS choice, firewall, that the app is connected to the gateway, and (for HTTPS) that the certificate is trusted.

abort.wrong_gateway: The endpoint now serves a different gateway.
